svg.title: A conducting sphere in an originally uniform electric field
svg.desc: Computed field lines around a neutral conducting sphere placed in a field that points to the right and was uniform before the sphere was there. Free charges in the sphere move until the field lines meet its surface at right angles: lines end on negative charge induced on the left side and start again on positive charge induced on the right side. There is no field inside the sphere, and far away the field is uniform again.
